outcome.answer: Yes. Several papers describe adaptive or dynamic retrieval at test time without retraining: ViSAR dynamically determines how many pages to retrieve and is training-free [1]. LAD-RAG also adaptively retrieves the necessary evidence without any top-k tuning [2], and LITTA improves retrieval without retriever retraining while making the accuracy-efficiency trade-off controllable by the number of query variants [6]. MAB-DQA and D2-ScaleAgent likewise dynamically reallocate retrieval budgets or expand retrieval based on query difficulty [9, 10].
